Compare {{cog|da|mage|t=mate}}, {{cog|is|maki|t=spouse}}. ====Noun==== {{en-noun}} # Any contest or trial of strength or skill, or to determine superiority. #: {{syn|en|competition|contest|trial}} #* {{RQ:Drayton Poems|chapter=Barons Warres|stanza=22|page=31|passage=''Ferrer'' his Taberd vvith rich Verry ſpred, / VVell knovvne in many a vvarlike '''match''' before; {{...}}}} #* {{RQ:Dryden Pastorals|passage=A solemn '''match''' was made; he lost the prize.}} ## {{senseid|en|Q118496986}} {{lb|en|sports}} A competitive sporting event such as a boxing meet, a baseball game, or a cricket match. ##: {{cot|en|practice|scrimmage|tryout}} ##: {{hyper|en|field day|tournament}} ##: {{syn|en|bout|competition|contest|event|game|matchup|meet|set|tournament|tourney}} ##: {{ux|en|My local team are playing in a '''match''' against their arch-rivals today.}} ##* {{RQ:nan-tws:Lim Hiong Seng|en|passage=Can you play billiards? / Yes, do you wish to have a '''match''' with me? / Let us simply play (a game) for pleasure.
